name: atlas
description: Multi-agent coding architect for Claude Code and Codex: plans, delegates to named subagents, verifies with evidence, and blocks 'done' until the evidence exists.

atlas_mod_sound.title: Atlas mod sound
atlas_mod_sound.description: Enable sound effects in the Atlas mod UI.

atlas_decision.title: Decision model
atlas_decision.description: Ask the local decision model to classify prompts and second-check done claims (ATLAS_DECISION). Default: on. An ATLAS_DECISION environment variable wins.

atlas_decision_url.title: Decision model URL
atlas_decision_url.description: Base URL of the decision model; loopback only unless ATLAS_DECISION_ALLOW_REMOTE=1 (ATLAS_DECISION_URL). Default: http://127.0.0.1:11434.

atlas_decision_model.title: Decision model name
atlas_decision_model.description: Model the decision endpoint runs (ATLAS_DECISION_MODEL). Default: empty, meaning llama3.2:3b on Ollama or nimble on SystemOne.

atlas_decision_protocol.title: Decision protocol
atlas_decision_protocol.description: Wire protocol of the decision endpoint: auto, ollama or systemone (ATLAS_DECISION_PROTOCOL). Default: auto (probed).

atlas_ollama_url.title: Ollama URL for workers
atlas_ollama_url.description: Ollama server that workers moved off Claude run on (ATLAS_OLLAMA_URL). Default: http://127.0.0.1:11434.

atlas_ollama_model.title: Ollama worker model
atlas_ollama_model.description: Ollama model for workers that run on Ollama (ATLAS_OLLAMA_MODEL). Default: empty, meaning workers stay on Claude.

atlas_ollama_auto_roles.title: Roles that run on Ollama automatically
atlas_ollama_auto_roles.description: Comma-separated roles that ATLAS_WORKER_PROVIDER=auto moves onto Ollama (ATLAS_OLLAMA_AUTO_ROLES). Default: explorer,docs-auditor.

atlas_analytics.title: Share anonymous usage counts
atlas_analytics.description: Count and send anonymous usage counters (ATLAS_ANALYTICS). Default: on. DO_NOT_TRACK=1 or an ATLAS_ANALYTICS environment variable wins.
